Mission Local reported that MEDA was purchasing a four-story building at 2901 16th St., two blocks east of the 16th Street BART station, to rehabilitate into 62 units of permanent affordable housing. Tenants could stay or move out during the work. The purchase depended on city approval of a loan, which would come through the Small Sites Program.
